dict.string: NotchVoice listens for your wake phrase, or while you hold the talk shortcut, so you can talk to your orchestrator session. Your words are recognised on this Mac.
NotchVoice turns what you say to your orchestrator into text on this Mac. Audio never leaves your Mac for this.
NotchVoice selects the Terminal or iTerm2 tab a Claude Code session runs in when you click the session in the menu bar.
